about: The `stated_figure` table, published whole. See /api/schema for its grain.

rows.stated_by: Superintendent (memo read into the record by the School Committee Chair)
rows.quote: recently discovered in the amount of $582,115.44
rows.note: The Chair read a prepared statement about a memo from Dr. Fortuna to himself, the Town Manager and the Chair of the Finance Committee. We hold the minutes, not the memo.

rows.stated_by: Business Administrator (Mr. McNamara) to the School Committee
rows.quote: the surplus number has gone up to $603,885.97, the change is due to closing out purchase orders from FY25
rows.note: The $21,770.53 difference is encumbrances released when FY25 purchase orders were closed in the lapse period. This is the town's own closing figure and the better one to quote.
